function.name: relay_directory_action
function.description: Read and coordinate this task action outline. Plan, focus, note a failed option without closing the action, observe partial progress or a fulfilled action with an explicit outcome, or block the action itself with a blocker classification. Host receipts remain distinct from agent-authored outcome claims. Include the action that delivers the requested result. If discovery is only an intermediate step, add and take the next useful authorized step rather than ending with a progress report. Supply only fields for the selected action. Read takes action alone. A ? marks an optional field: read: action; plan: action, actions, revision?; focus: action, id, revision?; refine: action, id, claim, doneChecks, dropCheckIds?, alternatives?, revision?; refine: action, id, claim, dropCheckIds, alternatives, doneChecks?, revision?; note: action, id, claim, receipts, checkResults?, revision?; observe: action, id, claim, receipts, outcome, candidateRows?, checkResults?, revision?; block: action, id, claim, blocker, receipts, revision?; block: action, id, claim, blocker, receipts?, revision?; block: action, id, claim, blocker, revision?. For refine, adding checks and retiring checks are separate variants; retiring requires alternatives. unresolved-effect uses the ledger receipts, so omit receipts for that blocker.

outcome.description: Required for observe: partial saves evidence without closing the action or unblocking dependencies; objective-met is only for the whole active objective.

blocker.description: For block only: why the whole step cannot proceed. search-limit-reached means the preplanned finite search scope was read, not elapsed time; configured deadlines are enforced by the host.

revision.description: Optional legacy echo. Model edits use the host-delivered snapshot; omit rather than calculating a revision.

candidateRows.description: For a qualifying contract, give distinct candidates and their source reads. For partial with no candidate checked, omit candidateRows or use []; objective-met needs qualifying rows.

id.description: Short ID using only letters, digits, underscore or hyphen; for example fully_remote.

function.name: relay_workspace
function.description: Read and edit this benchmark attempt, and run its fixed public check. read/list cover fixed task files and src; write/patch change only .cjs files below src; run accepts exactly node test-public.cjs. Paths are task-relative with forward slashes. Read the current source before editing, then inspect the saved bytes and actual command result. Supply only the fields for the selected action, including when a value would be empty. A ? marks an optional field: list: action, path?, depth?, limit?; read: action, path, startLine?, lineCount?; write: action, path, text, expectedHash?; patch: action, path, oldText, newText, expectedHash?; run: action, command, timeoutMs?.

action.description: Select one action and supply only its permitted fields.

path.description: One task-relative file or directory, using forward slashes. Only .cjs files below src are writable.

oldText.description: Exact nonempty source text that occurs once, for patch.

newText.description: Replacement text for patch; empty text deletes oldText.

expectedHash.description: Optional current-source SHA-256 for write or patch.

function.name: relay_code
function.description: Save explicit source code and verify its saved bytes, or check a saved file. save requires language, path and code; optional format defaults to raw. No prose or final-answer text is searched for code. check requires language, path and check:syntax or check:public. Saving does not run the source. Readback verification, syntax checking and public-test results are separate evidence; a syntax pass is not task correctness. Paths, writes and checks retain the attached workspace restrictions.

language.description: Source language, for example javascript, json or python. This does not select an executable.

path.description: One file path accepted by the attached workspace. No cwd override.

code.description: Complete source for save, separate from explanatory prose. Maximum 1 MiB of UTF-8 source.

format.description: Save only. raw preserves every byte; fenced accepts one whole fenced block, with no surrounding prose.

check.description: Check only. Uses an attached host checker; never accepts a model-supplied command. An unavailable checker is reported explicitly.

expectedHash.description: Expected current-file SHA-256. Save requires a backend with guarded writes. Check rejects a different source.

function.name: relay_skills
function.description: Find a skill for the current task. search matches skill names, descriptions and metadata; an empty query browses the catalog. Use nextOffset with the same query for another page. read takes a returned id and loads its full method, including human edits. This tool is read-only; reading a skill does not execute it.

id.description: Exact skill identifier returned by search.

limit.description: Metadata matches per page, defaults to 12.

offset.description: Search page offset. Use the returned nextOffset with the same query.
